text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - INC2031: embeddings-service tail latency spike detected in prod-usa-west-2. 90th/99th p50 increased above SLO at 2026-03-14T09:10Z. Automated paging sent to #eng-oncall.

Sarah N.: got the page, I'm taking primary. quick summary: high P99 for /v1/embeddings for requests >512 tokens, errors start to surface on dedicated pool r-emb-2. Metrics: 2m error rate ~4%, P99 latency 2.8s (normal ~0.2s).

Mike C.: thanks — are we seeing increased QPS or just latency per request?

Sarah N.: QPS steady. It's per-request token-length correlated. I suspect KV cache eviction pressure + a bad quantization kernel path triggered on r-emb-2 nodes after last config rollout.

Jordan R.: I rolled the config earlier (rollout 2026-03-14T08:45Z) which enabled compressed-kv=true on dedicated. Reverting might be quickest mitigation.

Lina (SRE): copying runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-latency (pager links). Key steps below.

oncall-ops-bot: runbook step executed by Sarah N.: `check-pool-health --pool r-emb-2` returned high mem pressure on 3/8 hosts.

Sarah N.: Mitigations in progress:
- scaling up dedicated pool r-emb-2 by +4 instances (in flight)
- temporary route: shadow long-requests to r-emb-canary (no traffic) to validate quant kernel rollback
- disabling compressed-kv on r-emb-2 (will rollback config)

Mike C.: If scale doesn't drop P99, we should fallback long-requests to hosted embeddings (higher cost) to protect customers.

Sarah N.: agreed. Starting scale now. Command I ran:
```
redwoodctl capacity scale --pool r-emb-2 --add 4 --reason "INC2031 - tail latency"
```

incident-bot: :information_source: Autoscaler accepted request, provisioning started (est 90s)

Jordan R.: also preparing a rollback patch to toggle `compressed-kv=false` for the pool. Patch ready: `cfg rollback 2026-03-14-0845` — will apply after Sarah confirms.

Sarah N.: applying rollback now on one host to test, will wait 2m.

oncall-ops-bot: note: customer-impact tag updated to `degraded` on INC2031. Affected: batch embedding jobs >512 tokens and long-run inference endpoints. For customers on Dedicated, traffic routed to their pool (may be impacted).

Mike C.: which customer tenants are hitting >512 tokens frequently? can we message support to preempt?  

Sarah N.: quick list from logs: acme-ads, data-sci-pro, beta-recs. I'll ping support and account execs.

Sarah N.: rollback test on single host looks promising: P99 dropped from 2.8s -> 0.22s for test requests. I'll proceed to roll the patch to remaining hosts in r-emb-2.

Jordan R.: prepping the rollout: `cfg apply rollback 2026-03-14-0845 --target r-emb-2 --parallel 2` — will stagger.

Lina (SRE): monitoring checklist reminder:
- check KV cache miss rates
- verify CPU/GPU utilization on hosts
- check kernel-selection logs `/var/log/serving/kernel-selection.log` for exceptions
- confirm no other pools started trending

Sarah N.: rolling to remaining hosts now. Parallel 2.

oncall-ops-bot: deploy wave 1 completed. Hosts 1-2 patched. Metrics: P99 dropped to 0.3s cluster-wide for those hosts.

Sarah N.: wave 2 in progress.

Mike C.: I'm drafting the customer impact note for Support: short blurb + mitigation steps. Will post in #customer-success and tag account owners.

Sarah N.: wave 2 completed. All hosts patched. Cluster P99 back to baseline ~0.25s. Error rate back to <0.1%.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INC2031 mitigated. Auto-escalation disabled. Please hold for 15m monitoring before closing.

Sarah N.: handing off to Mike for next 2hr watch. Primary: Mike C. Secondary: Jordan R. Coverage gap: none expected, but if provisioning or rollback steps re-trigger, page both primary+secondary and escalate to Lina.

Mike C.: taking primary. I'll keep alerts on, running `alert inspect INC2031` on 5m cadence.

Jordan R.: standing by as secondary, will follow up on any config drift.

Lina (SRE): added runbook pointer and post-incident checklist to ticket INC2031. Suggested follow-ups: root cause analysis to confirm why compressed-kv path regressed, add automated canary for quant-kernel changes.

Sarah N.: notes for handoff:
- Active alert cleared but monitor for P99 growth >0.5s
- Mitigations performed: scale +4 (reverted automatically after 30m), config rollback `compressed-kv=false` on r-emb-2
- Commands and logs: see incident artifacts at https://incidents.redwood/INC2031
- Next steps: RCA, add canary, notify customers (Mike)

Mike C.: acknowledged. I'll open a follow-up thread in #postmortems after stabilization.

Sarah N.: thanks team. Leaving primary to Mike and heading offline for 45m. :thumbsup:

oncall-ops-bot: note: handoff recorded. Primary: Mike C. Secondary: Jordan R. Handoff_ts: 1772527056
